Title: General availability: Data-in Replication for Azure Database for MySQL

Body.Content:
Azure Database for MySQL now supports Data-in Replication. Use this feature to synchronize data from a MySQL server running on-premises, in virtual machines, or database services outside Azure into the Azure Database for MySQL service.

Data-in Replication was designed for scenarios like these:

  • Hybrid data synchronization: Sync data between your on-premises servers and Azure Database for MySQL.
  • Multi-cloud synchronization: Sync data between different cloud providers (including VMs and other database services) and Azure Database for MySQL.

Learn more about Data-in Replication and how to configure Data-in Replication. 

Get started with Azure Database for MySQL using the Azure portal or Azure CLI.
